maria: Heads-up: new quant candidate 'Nyx-24b-q' surfaced from bench. Looks like a useful cost win but shows some flicker on long-context. Need quick priority call.

anand: What's the headline tradeoff? cost vs latency vs quality?

maria: Quick score (0-5 each): Throughput 4, Cost 5, Latency 2, Quality 3, Risk 2 -> 16/25. Notes: ~20% token cost reduction vs Atlas40b-qt on p4d, median latency +7%, p95 within limits for Dedicated. 8k context shows token jitter and a few generation artifacts.

lucy: Any immediate customer win (enterprise pilot / cost-sensitive customers) or is this mostly infra savings?

maria: Dedicated customers on trial would see clear $ savings. Hosted customers could benefit but median latency regressions make it risky during our latency SLO sprint.

cheng: Recommend Dedicated-only canary first. Also run long-context (8k) smoke under load — we saw quant artifacts on similar models before.

eval-bot: scheduled: safety-suite (2k samples), hallucination-bench (1k), stability-smoke (8k, 200 requests). ETA ~6h.

infra-bot: draft canary plan: canary-dedicated/nyx-24b-q -> capacity: 2 nodes. A/B comparator with Atlas40b-qt traffic split 10/90. Rollback if p95 latency >220ms OR error rate increases >1% OR safety regression >1%.

anand: Roadmap check: current sprint is focused on latency micro-optimizations for hosted. Pulling infra/serving to onboard could delay that. Suggest next-sprint onboarding unless evals show strong quality win.

maria: Operational proposal: run evals + small few-shot prompt patch today. If safety regressions <=1% and hallucination delta <=0.5%, proceed to Dedicated canary next Tue. If canary passes for 2w with no hard fails, consider Hosted rollout in 2 weeks.

lucy: I'll build comparator dashboards and set alerts: conv-quality delta, safety regressions, token cost, p50/p95 latency. ETA 48h.

cheng: Add a stress test: quantization-heat under burst at 8k context during canary.

maria: Action items:
- eval-bot: run safety + hallucination + stability suites (ETA 6h)
- lucy: comparator dashboards + alerts (ETA 48h)
- infra: schedule Dedicated canary + long-context smoke
- anand: confirm sprint impact & go/no-go

maria: Will post results back here. Hard guardrails -> immediate rollback and postmortem.

lucy: :thumbsup:
